args.lesson: When a source looks self-contradictory, search the whole record before declaring the value unresolved: OCDS notice 104449-2026 states the six-year maximum explicitly in tender.lots[].options.description, which r2 missed while removing the operator-flagged inference. Grep every free-text field (description, renewal, options) for the term before writing. A claude-provider NEEDS_WORK review is accepted by the host, but an APPROVE for the revised digest must come from a different provider or the founder. Since all channels stay blocked, no further revisions unless a new defect is found.
